newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yaohan Int'l ups privatisation offer.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Int'l ups privatisation offer.

text.p: Yaohan International Holdings Ltd has raised the share exchange ratio in its plan to privatise Yaohan Hongkong Corp Ltd, the companies said on Thursday.
Yaohan International said it would offer 505 new Yaohan International shares for every 1,000 shares of Yaohan Hongkong held by minority shareholders, up from 451 shares.

Yaohan International said it raised the exchange ratio because the new Yaohan International shares would not be entitled to receive the final dividend of HK$0.089 per share for the year ended March 31, 1996.
Cash entitlement of HK$0.381 per Yaohan Hongkong share remains unchanged, the statement said.

Last month, Yaohan International proposed to privatise its 41.95 percent-owned loss-making department store unit Yaohan Hongkong by issue of 451 new Yaohan International shares for every 1,000 Yaohan Hongkong shares held.
Minority shareholders could also choose to take a cash entitlement of HK$0.381 for every Yaohan Hongkong share.
